assessments.reasoning: The XPath 3.1 constructor rule compares evaluated atomic keys using op:same-key. It requires dynamic error XQDY0137 when at least two entries compare the same under that operation.

challenge.method: Check whether the trigger depends on repeated source spelling, whether the constructor may keep one duplicate, and whether the rule covers map merging.
challenge.results: The trigger depends on key values. Once the comparison succeeds for two entries, the constructor must raise the specified error. The passage governs construction and supplies no duplicate-handling rule for merging existing maps.

limitations: The rule applies to map construction and distinct-key checking. It does not describe operations that combine existing maps.
The dynamic error class need not indicate when an implementation first detects the error. The candidate does not govern merging maps or alternate errors.
